name: 06340 · Groton, CT
findings: ZIP 06340 (Groton) has 119 nonprofit organizations. 63 of them (53%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 55 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 06340 (Groton) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 06340 (Groton) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).
